state.instructions: Evaluate an owner-local reservation-state proposal using these source facts.
state.facts: An allowance choice is stored as pending during hold but prepare can omit the request because its flag defaults to false. A first-arriving paid event sets review; reserve completion accepts only pending for consumption. No free decision runs at final consumption. arrive grants reception and tests can_work, paid and consumed; existing Booking viewing grants scoped reservation_manager and authenticated owner only. Physical presence persists through cancellation. Each resource decides capacity. BillingV1 has charge/cancel/refund plus settled; MembershipV1 exposes reserve/consume/release/eligibility plus changed, and neither interface provides reconcile.
state.actual_code: scenario arrive(booking:Booking) by=reception; require can_work(actor,booking.parent.location) and booking.status==confirmed and booking.payment==paid and booking.allowance in [not_required,consumed]; policy Booking read=reservation_manager and can_work(actor,row.parent.location); policy Booking read=authenticated where=row.account==actor

coordination.instructions: Would it correct those ordering failures to keep a paid awaiting-allowance booking pending, honor the saved choice in prepare, re-evaluate free at consumption request and confirmation, match source/delivery identities and leave terminal statuses unchanged on delayed failure, without claiming sends establish success?

reception_read.instructions: Is a new narrowly field-limited, location-checked reception Booking read policy appropriate for its existing UI and operation scope, with own and manager reads and mutation guards preserved?
